lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 119, for issue 118: Ctrl+A selects everything inside the current expanded folder.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one nineteen, for issue one eighteen: control A selects everything inside the current expanded folder.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
Ctrl+A now picks the folder from the cursor row and selects that folder's rows in one go.
lines.say: Control A now picks the folder from the cursor row and selects that folder's rows in one go.

lines.caption: You press Ctrl+A, or pick Select All Files from the Edit menu, as before.
lines.say: You press control A, or pick Select All Files from the Edit menu, as before.

lines.caption: If the cursor row is an expanded folder, that's the folder. Otherwise it's the row's parent folder.
The range runs from the folder's first child to the last visible row inside it.
One call selects the whole range, then any Loading rows are unselected. The cursor stays put.
The icon and compact views keep their own Select All, unchanged.
With no folder to pick, such as a top-level file, it selects the whole view, minus Loading rows.
And while a folder's files are still loading, the old selection is cleared, since there's nothing in it to select yet.
Ctrl+A used to select every row in the view, so selecting one opened folder's files took Shift+click or Shift+Down.
lines.say: Control A used to select every row in the view, so selecting one opened folder's files took shift click or shift down.

lines.caption: The folder comes from the cursor, the row with the focus outline, not from the selection. The cursor never moves.
The issue asked for a new Ctrl+Shift+A action. The owner chose to give its behaviour to Ctrl+A instead.
lines.say: The issue asked for a new control shift A action. The owner chose to give its behaviour to control A instead.

lines.caption: Nothing new is bound: Ctrl+A and the Edit menu call the details view's Select All, where this PR's code is.
lines.say: Nothing new is bound: control A and the Edit menu call the details view's Select All, where this PR's code is.

lines.caption: A file inside a folder, or a collapsed folder inside it, picks that folder.
A folder with thousands of rows is still one call, and the folder row itself isn't selected.
With Expandable Folders on, the whole view case now also leaves out Loading rows, and reports the change once.
This table sums it up: an expanded folder, a row inside one, or a top-level row.
The icon and compact views and the loading case, which now clears the selection, have no test of their own.
From inside a folder, Ctrl+A no longer selects everything. Move to a top-level row first, with Home or End.
lines.say: From inside a folder, control A no longer selects everything. Move to a top-level row first, with Home or End.

lines.caption: The PR changes one source file and one comment in a header, adds one test script, and adds this page and its narration.
To undo it, revert this PR. It adds no setting.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The test checks each case from the issue's table, on the same files, now with Ctrl+A.
lines.say: The test checks each case from the issue's table, on the same files, now with control A.

lines.caption: It checks the whole view cases against the old Ctrl+A, and reads the selection by copying and pasting it.
lines.say: It checks the whole view cases against the old control A, and reads the selection by copying and pasting it.

lines.caption: The first design, on Ctrl+Shift+A, built in a cloud container, and the smoke test and 18 other tests passed.
lines.say: The first design, on control shift A, built in a cloud container, and the smoke test and eighteen other tests passed.

lines.caption: The new test failed at first, because a click left the cursor on the wrong row. The test was fixed.
Re-run on that first design, it passed every check: inside a folder, on a folder, the Edit menu, and the whole view.
The final Ctrl+A code and CI's review fixes were only compiled here; no full build of them has finished yet.
lines.say: The final control A code and C I's review fixes were only compiled here; no full build of them has finished yet.

lines.caption: The loading case and the icon and compact views were not tested.
CI builds and tests the final code on this PR, and its screenshots get audited there.
A fresh review agent found 7 problems in the first design; 4 are fixed, and the switch to Ctrl+A settled the rest.
lines.say: A fresh review agent found seven problems in the first design; four are fixed, and the switch to control A settled the rest.

lines.caption: A folder still loading had cleared the selection by accident, and two pieces of code were made simpler.
The fourth was this page itself: without it, CI's explainer job would have failed.
GTK's Ctrl+Shift+A keeps working, no menu item is added, and Ctrl+A skips Loading rows. Invert Selection still doesn't.
lines.say: G T K's control shift A keeps working, no menu item is added, and control A skips Loading rows. Invert Selection still doesn't.

lines.caption: CI then reviewed both designs at level high, and found 13 low findings.
lines.say: C I then reviewed both designs at level high, and found thirteen low findings.

lines.caption: Four are fixed: a loading folder now gets an empty selection, and the Loading check is lighter and narrower.
lines.say: Four are fixed: a loading folder now gets an empty selection, and the Loading check is lighter and narrower.

lines.caption: Three went away with the Ctrl+Shift+A action.
lines.say: Three went away with the control shift A action.

lines.caption: Invert Selection can still pick Loading rows. That's accepted, because upstream already fixed it for 4.22.
lines.say: Invert Selection can still pick Loading rows. That's accepted, because upstream already fixed it for four twenty-two.

lines.caption: Three unconfirmed low findings from the later review are accepted.
lines.say: Three unconfirmed low findings from the later review are accepted.

lines.caption: The owner accepted the last two: one select_range stays faster, and Ctrl+A already behaved that way on main.
lines.say: The owner accepted the last two: one range selection stays faster, and control A already behaved that way on main.

lines.caption: Real folders on the owner's desktop, the new Ctrl+A habit, and speed in a huge folder are only seen after the merge.
lines.say: Real folders on the owner's desktop, the new control A habit, and speed in a huge folder are only seen after the merge.

lines.caption: The PR, its changes, CI's screenshots and the issue are all linked here.
Part 3. What comes later.
No open issue depends on this one. Issue 117 will run this PR's test, and upstream's 4.22 brings the fix for R4.
lines.say: No open issue depends on this one. Issue one seventeen will run this PR's test, and upstream's four twenty-two brings the fix for R four.

lines.caption: Upstream 4.22 refuses Loading rows in every selection, so Invert Selection gets fixed there.
lines.say: Upstream four twenty-two refuses Loading rows in every selection, so Invert Selection gets fixed there.

lines.caption: In short: Ctrl+A now selects just the expanded folder you're in.
lines.say: In short: control A now selects just the expanded folder you're in.
